exact: long-chain fatty acyl CoA biosynthetic process

definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of a long-chain fatty-acyl-CoA any derivative of coenzyme A in which the sulfhydryl group is in a thioester linkage with a long-chain fatty-acyl group. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.
label: Synthesis of very long-chain fatty acyl-CoAs
